title: council first live acceptance run on a real contested decision
description: The council skill aligned at r5 in abacus with its first live run designated as the acceptance test - it has never run. Execute one full council on a genuinely contested decision (candidates from recent abacus work: the tree-claim TTL amendment shape, the worktree dispatch protocol, or any operator-nominated fork). The run must honor the skill contract in skills/council/SKILL.md: frozen review subject (exact commit or brief-embedded text with hash), herdr version recorded verbatim in the manifest, owner ledger initialized on disk, full reviewer responses captured into the ledger, and the brief passing the reader test (a reader given only brief.md can state the decision under review). Acceptance: completed run artifacts + a findings list; skill amendments (if any) get their own review round; README.md validation ledger updated in the landing commit.
